purpose: Client-side fork of a conversation on a chat.done carrying compaction, plus its auto-continue: pure fork construction (src/lib/fork.ts), orchestration inside use-chat-generation (stash payload; after ownership and applied steps, build, add, select, send), the compaction step kind with its card/back-link, sidebar visibility and transcript turn-boundary handling.

public_api.name: buildFork
public_api.signature: (original: Conversation, payload: CompactionPayload, now?: Date) => Conversation
public_api.description: Pure. System steps of the original + one compaction step; forkedFrom; inherited model/provider/settings/tools; '<title> (compacted)', titleEdited true; requestContexts []; fresh id/timestamps.

public_api.name: compactionContent
public_api.description: summary, then 'Remaining work:' section when remainingWork is present.

public_api.name: useChatGeneration onFork / streamConversationResponse(conversation, options)
public_api.signature: onFork?: (fork: Conversation) => void; options: { withoutCompactContext?: boolean; contextRequest?: ContextRequestFields }
public_api.description: Fork orchestration. The fork's first send excludes compact_context from the request's tools and carries the original's context fields explicitly.

public_api.name: useConversations.addForkedConversation
public_api.description: Prepends the fork to the list and selects it.

public_api.name: orderVisibleConversations
public_api.description: Visible when the conversation has a user or compaction step.

public_api.name: Transcript props forkOrigin / onOpenConversation
public_api.description: Back-link above the compaction card; plain text when the original no longer exists.

owned_data: fork record shape (system steps + one compaction step)
